# C4 Diagrams Folder

This folder contains C4 architecture diagrams in SVG format for the RealEstate application.

## Expected Files

Place your C4 diagrams as SVG files in this folder:

- `01-system-context.svg` - System Context diagram (Level 1)
- `02-container.svg` - Container diagram (Level 2) 
- `03-api-components.svg` - API Components diagram (Level 3)
- `04-webapp-components.svg` - Web App Components diagram (Level 3)
- `05-deployment.svg` - Deployment diagram

## Tools for Creating C4 Diagrams

- [Structurizr](https://structurizr.com/)
- [PlantUML with C4 extension](https://github.com/plantuml-stdlib/C4-PlantUML)
- [Draw.io/Lucidchart](https://app.diagrams.net/)
- [C4 Builder](https://c4builder.com/)

## Usage

These diagrams are referenced in the documentation at `/docs/architecture/diagrams/c4-architecture-diagrams.md` and will be automatically displayed when the SVG files are added to this folder.
